Roman chairs offer good weight support, can be folded for storage, and are great for exercising your back.

The bench arrived quickly, which is a big plus. Unfortunately, the resistance bands and some washers were missing from the package, which takes away from the overall experience. That said, the bench itself is solid and delivers good value for the price. Overall, a decent buy, but quality control could definitely be improved.

Was looking for a back extension machine.. have injuries to the discs in my back and neck. This is a lovely bench to use for the price. Works wonderful and it's lightweight enough for the wife to use as well. The bottom plate for the feet is quite small, especially for someone with big feet like me... But aside from that it's well worth the money

It's "working" as expected. The backpad can be set only in 4 positions - but it's more than enough. Can be fold/set with special screws what you can easily take out/put back, although one of them is really stuck for me so I can't fold it. The ropes is really short, half the size what you can see on the images. The whole pad seems/sounds unstable, but it real it's really stable for me.
